# X.509 certificate

Decode X.509 certificates: subject, SAN, validity, key and fingerprints.

Category: Encoders · ID: `x509` · Search terms: certificate, pem, der, tls, ssl, crt, fingerprint

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui x509 [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. PEM, or DER in Base64 or hex

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/x509`), so they are what the tool prints.
